description: Election Commission - Announcing that a Member of Parliament was Elected for Ratnapura Electoral District.
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to a resignation, which falls under electoral processes. It involves the declaration of a new Member of Parliament to fill a vacancy in accordance with constitutional and parliamentary election procedures. This content directly relates to election results and declarations, making it clearly an Elections Gazette (Type 7) rather than a government personnel or structural change.
